loop.top3_why: The series shows unstable model ranking and moderate noise, favoring a robust, simple combination. The mean over the stable 5‑model pool (A) achieves the same per‑window performance as the weighted variants but without the risk of over‑fitting to the high‑variance inverse‑error weights. loop.top3_why_not: B and C use inverse‑error weighting on the same pool, which can amplify the influence of a single model’s error estimate in a noisy, low‑sample‑size setting. Their per‑window differences are negligible and likely due to estimation noise, so they do not provide a clear advantage over the mean strategy.
